data.text: Probe E run 2026-10-04 (docs/research/probe-e-2026-10.md, rubric written before the runs): 15 Sonnet agents, tasks KAD-64/65/66/67/69 on a snapshot of 8250e2d, arms bare (title only) / journal (task show + decision list) / journal + the two doc sections search returns. Correct first step 2/5, 5/5, 5/5. Questions 29/34/32, median tokens 102k/115k/124k. Criterion 5 fails as written: no cut in questions or tokens on any task, tokens up 11-32%. What the journal changed was correctness: without it agents built the wrong thing on KAD-64 (no topic), KAD-66 (a heading selector, not DOC-N:a-b) and KAD-67 (any event, not the close). Docs added nothing over the journal. So the site gets no speed claim; the honest one is 2/5 -> 5/5 at ~12% more tokens, n=5, one agent per cell, graded by the agent that had implemented the tasks. Criteria 1-4 are the engineering defaults: no code was written, nothing to check.
